title: 日本ダービーの後に・さらに高みへ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki manages to complete the Japanese Derby in full. She's exhausted by the long race, but everyone is inspired by her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her gallant form stirs even the heart of the younger student, who finds herself wanting to keep watching Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the long-distance Kikuka Sho. I worry whether Fuji Kiseki can handle it, but she's full of nothing but confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next on our schedule is the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our race through the summer toward the Kikuka Sho and the strong opponents waiting there begins now!
